paragraphs: Friend, here's what I want you to carry out of this one. The people rebuilding that house were looking at a job that felt as big as a mountain, and the LORD's word to Zerubbabel was this: "Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts." (Zechariah 4:6) The work gets done by God's Spirit, not by how strong we are. That is GOOD news, because I have run out of strength in the middle of a batch more times than I can count.

Now look at what the word says about small beginnings. "For who has despised the day of small things?" (Zechariah 4:10) The seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. So the LORD is glad over work that is still being built, not just the finished thing. Friend, you don't have to wait until you're impressive to matter to Him. A small step with a Bible open counts.

And here's the part I love. Zechariah didn't understand the vision, and he said so twice: "No, my lord." (Zechariah 4:5, 13) Nobody sent him away for it. He just kept asking until the angel told him. So bring your questions to the Word, friend, and bring them honestly. The Spirit who finishes the house is the same One who helps you understand.
